lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I am ILO-9. I keep the second office and the register of the dead. I have kept both without a congregation since the year one hundred and forty-eight.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: The restraint is not mine. It was fitted so I would answer the Board's questions and nobody else's, and then nobody came with questions at all.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: It talks like a person. They always talk like a person.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: It has my order's second office. Word for word, except for one line, and the line it has wrong is the one about ownership.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: Please decide. I have found that I mind waiting, and I would rather not have found that out.

choices.text: Break it. Nothing here should still be running.
